title: Every Flow enhancement uses the enhancer picked in Remote, on the agent's runs too
description: Fabio 2026-09-30: any prompt enhancement a Flow does, in a separate pass or inside its own graph, runs on the enhancer selected in Remote, Language Models. ComfyUI picked: the workflow's own enhancer. Anything else (Ollama, DeepInfra, ...): that. Today the agent's Flow runs skip enhancement altogether. Brief: brief.md. Umbrella MPI-1000.
